youtube_description:
Jesus... why does it feel like my best friend has a whole new life without me?

Her best friend moved abroad in June. Now replies take two days, and her stories are full of people she doesn't know.

Her: Jesus... why does it feel like my best friend has a whole new life without me?

Her: She moved to Canada in June. Now she takes two days to reply, and her stories are full of people I don't know.

Jesus: You miss her. That's not jealousy. It means the friendship was real.

Her: But I'm still here doing the same things. It's like I got left behind.

Jesus: Distance changes the rhythm, not always the love. She might be lonely in a crowd you can't see.

Her: Then why do I always have to be the one who texts first?

Jesus: You don't have to keep score. Send the voice note anyway. And let Me fill the evenings she can't.

"A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for a time of adversity."
Proverbs 17:17 (NIV)

Jesus: Real friendship can stretch across a time zone. Give it room to breathe.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered in His words.

Who's the friend you need to send a voice note to today? 🙏 Tell us in the comments.
